segments.text: Sasara is a new heroine who appears in the releases subsequent to the PlayStation 2 version. She is one school year older than the protagonist and the student council vice-president/the later president. She has a cold demeanour and strict attitude and as a result, her only friend is Maaryan. When it is time for Maaryan to graduate, Sasara is saddened because her only friend would be leaving her and even attempts to convince Maaryan not to graduate. Takaaki becomes acquainted with her after he is chosen to be a volunteer to help the student council with an event, but when Sasara becomes president, under certain circumstances he becomes the treasurer. While working with Takaaki in the student council she begins to develop a crush on him.
From Wikipedia
An apothecary with ears and tail like an animal's. Separated from her homeland, she encounters Haku while traveling along leisurely.
She gets excited when it comes to bathing and often ends her sentences with "-かな～" or, in English, "I think".
She is the daughter of Hakuoro and Yuzuha.
The youngest princess of Kujyuri, one of Yamato's vassal states.
A refined but shy and lovely young woman.
She encountered Haku and Kuon while travelling to the capital to give tribute to the Emperor.
She has kept a Hororon bird called Cocopo since she was little.
The protagonist of the story.
Finding himself collapsed in the middle of nowhere with barely any clothes on his back, he was rescued by Kuon and given a name.
Having lost his memories: his real identity is a mystery.
Neither hard-working nor earnest, his quick thinking is this young man's biggest asset.
His complete lack of physical strength greatly worries Kuon.

Ukon's younger sister and the youngest candidate to ever pass the very difficult court exam making her into one of the few qualified for the position of court-scholar. Because of her young age however, her academic ambitions have been put on hold for now, a constant source of irritation for the child prodigy.
An intellectual girl with a massive sweet-tooth and a passion for studying the ancient times, however she seems to have a soft spot for her brother.
The Imperial General of the Right. One of the Twin Shields of Yamato, along with Mikazuchi.
His face is always covered by a mask.
He is skilled in both the arts of war and peace, earning him the trust of both the people and the emperor.
A traveler and mercenary captain Haku and Kuon encounter in a remote Kujyuri village.

While rough around the edges and a little boisterous, he commands immense respect from his men, and is currently contracted to escort a caravan of offerings to the Imperial Capital. He is also Nekone's older brother.
From official site

A noble and scholar who specializes in creating fire magic with the aid of complex dance rituals that may appear comical to the untrained eye. After being "saved" by Haku, Maroro becomes attached to him.

A girl who leads a clan of thieves titled after her name, the Nosuri Thieves. She is a lively thief who has a big chest and is not very well organized. She has a penchant for the dramatic, and her younger brother Ougi can eternally be found at her side, facilitating her grandiose schemes.
The assistant and younger brother of Nosuri. He appears to be very sharp and has good manners despite being young.

A master swordsman who bears the title of Mirage Blade, a moniker fashioned for his infamous swordplay techniques, thought to be so lightning-quick that observers can only catch a fleeting afterimage of each stroke.
Wanders the world to hone his craft, and answers to no man in this pursuit.
From official site
Jachdwalt's highly energetic young daughter.
Often mistaken for a boy due to her masculine speech.
Accompanies her father wherever he goes.
From official site
Enigmatic and capricious twins who appear and disappear seemingly at random, nearly identical but for Uruuru's fair skin distinguishing her from Saraana's tan.
They seem to be capable of hiding themselves beyond mundane sight, and use this ability to follow Haku and his companions undetected—but to what end is unclear at best.
From official site
The Imperial General of the Left. One of the Twin Shields of Yamato, along with Oshtor.
A girl with a perpetually relaxed demeanour.
Far from shy, she carries herself with confidence and an always cheery disposition. Her manner of speaking is slightly refined.
Although starry-eyed and on a constant quest for love she is also quite the master of the spear.
Her pet Kurarin can be constantly seen riding on her head.
The prince of a country called Ennakamuy, he is a well-mannered boy with a small stature.
A bit of a worry-wart and easily flustered but his skill with the bow is without fault.
He is sworn brothers with Oshtor.
The young, pampered Imperial Princess of Yamato and the heiress to the throne of her father, the divine Mikado.
She speaks in the lofty, regal manner characteristic of high nobility, and possesses a unique innocence and naivety.
Adored by the people of her empire.
From official site
Known as Munechika the Guardian. She is one of Yamato's military paragons, the Eight Pillar Generals, and bearer of one of the vaunted Akuruka masks.
As her title implies, she excels in defensive and siegebreaking tactics, and attacks against Yamato by barbarian hordes and organized militaries alike have fallen to the wayside before her prowess.
In peacetime, she acts as governess to Anju, who often selfishly ropes her into mischief.
From official site
Owner and master of the Hakurokaku Inn, a popular establishment within the Imperial Capital.
A beautiful woman with an air of grace and elegance, there is a sense of exoticism about her that reminds one of distant lands...
From official site
A worker at Hakurokaku Inn, a popular establishment within the Imperial Capital.
She approaches all things with the utmost seriousness, but nevertheless seems to struggle with her housekeeping duties.
From official site
The warmaster of Tuskur.
He rides a pure white steed into battle alongside his second-in-command, Kurou.
He is a skilled tactician, able to make calm and precise decisions in any situation, and a peerless master of the spear.
From official site
A warrior of Tuskur and Benawi's right-hand man.
He prides himself on his strength and experience on the battlefield.
He comes across as brash, fearless and stouthearted.
One of the ambassadors from Tuskur, and Eruruu's younger sister.
She seems to have the body language of a small woodland animal, and she speaks with a distinct terseness, veering from being simply laconic to painfully blunt.
She is often seen with a giant white tiger-like creature named Mukkuru, and a holy animal named Gachatara.
From official site

A kamunagi (priestess) of Tuskur who wields powerful thaumaturgy. She moves with an ethereal grace, and has grand black wings on her back. She comes to Yamato as an ambassador on behalf of the nation of Tuskur. She is a princess of the Onkamiyamukai.
From official site
Enigmatic and capricious twins who appear and disappear seemingly at random, nearly identical but for Uruuru's fair skin distinguishing her from Saraana's tan.
They seem to be capable of hiding themselves beyond mundane sight, and use this ability to follow Haku and his companions undetected—but to what end is unclear at best.
From official site

To fulfill Oshtor's aspirations, Haku wears the mask, so that he may act in his friend's stead. He makes use of Oshtor's status and connections along with his own intelligence in order to put Anju on the imperial throne.
The Pillar General known as the Shadowlight.
With the help of his trusty Yatanawarabe, he moonlights as an artist of erotica such as may appeal to the prurient interests of noble young ladies.
He is a clone of the Mikado and the older brother of Anju, and the nephew of Haku.
Rulutieh's father.
Raikou's retainer.
Gaunji bait.
Atuy's father, a Pillar General, and the owlo of Shyahoro.
Renowned for his prowess as a naval commander.
Zeguni's daughter.

Tamaki is also childhood friends with both Konomi and Takaaki: the two see her as an older sister. She left them when they were both children, having to go to an all-girls boarding school. Her promise to come back to Takaaki and Konomi in the final year of high school is what prompted her to leave her boarding school. In the game, she is one year ahead of Takaaki. She is very confident and comes from a rich family. She is well-versed in traditional Japanese arts and traditions, yet still is a modern girl in her own right. In her group consisting of Konomi, Takaaki and Yuuji, she is the strong and dominant personality and acts as the older sister figure. She often addresses herself as "Tama-onee-chan".
In the game's Tamaki scenario, she is followed by a group of three girls from her boarding school.

The three attempt to separate her from Takaaki as they are "in love" with her. In the process of evading the girls, she declares Takaaki to be her boyfriend and proves it with a kiss: at which point the three girls realize they have failed and return to their school.
From Wikipedia

Dorry and Guraa are twin archers serving under Oboro. There are several ways to tell them apart: Dorry has purple eyes while Guraa's are blue, and the bottom part of their matching garments is blue on Dorry and red on Guraa.
From Wikipedia
Their gender is difficult to ascertain, even by other characters. In the game, Oboro and the twins themselves state that they are male.

The baby of Mutikapa from Kakaerayura Forest. He considers Aruruu, who raised him, to be his mother. Despite being large and fierce in battle, is really a big softie.
From in-game encyclopedia
The emperor of Yamato and the father of Anju.
